purpose: Define deterministic forward and reverse traceability across identities, Topics, structure, operations, events and explicit flows so canonical mechanisms can be followed end-to-end in both directions without semantic guessing.

value.name: Forward trace request
output: higher-level consumers, Topics, mechanisms and flows

value.name: Reverse trace request
input: Topic, operation, mechanism or higher-level action
output: lower-level canonical semantics, structures and runtime mechanisms

value.name: Trace foundational identity forward
outputs: explicit users, Topic memberships, compositions, operations and flows

value.name: Trace mechanism backward
inputs: resolved Topic, mechanism, operation or flow
outputs: explicit lower-level semantic and runtime foundations

value.name: Trace complete mechanism
outputs: composed Topic surfaces + mechanism-specific causality + foundations

value.name: Trace foundational mechanism usage
outputs: all explicit higher-level references and uses

forward_trace.question: Where is this foundational semantic or mechanism explicitly used?

reverse_trace.question: What lower-level canonical semantics and mechanisms explicitly realize this Topic, mechanism, operation or flow?

provenance.rule: Every trace hop preserves the explicit canonical edge/ref that justifies the hop.
provenance.forbidden: A trace hop that exists only because two items appear nearby in a directory, Topic projection or renderer.

value.mechanism_trace_rule: A mechanism Topic traces through composed Topics for reused semantics and through its own behavior.flows only for mechanism-specific causality.
value.foundation_trace_rule: A foundational primitive traces forward only to explicit references/uses; popularity or naming similarity is not a trace edge.
value.closure_rule: Bidirectional traceability is closed when all significant forward and reverse hops are explicit and no generic reader must invent a missing hop.

semantics.identity_rule: This member gives an exact owner-scoped identity to the literal Flow token without adding semantics beyond the owning Flow reference field and the preserved source literal.
semantics.interpretation_rule: Consumers may use this identity as an opaque declared Flow symbol. No meaning may be inferred from spelling, whitespace, filename, path or similarity to another symbol.
semantics.authority_rule: A Flow symbol is descriptive/causal model data only and never grants runtime authority, capability, ownership or execution permission.
semantics.scope_rule: Identity is scoped semantically to the defining contract; identical source literals in another contract or another Flow-ref role are not automatically the same semantic identity.

value.purpose: Group deterministic forward and reverse canonical trace semantics.

invariants.rule: Every canonical trace hop is justified by explicit structured canonical data.
Every forward/reverse trace item retains the edge/reference that included it.
Traceability is a read surface and does not alter canonical semantics.

hard_gates.condition: A significant trace hop requires filename, path, prose, naming similarity, renderer position or domain-specific heuristic inference.
A traced item cannot identify the explicit canonical reference or edge that included it.
A higher-level significant mechanism cannot be traced to its lower-level explicit foundations.
A foundational significant mechanism has explicit higher-level users that cannot be reconstructed by a generic reader.
Topic inheritance/composition trace order is interpreted as execution causality instead of explicit behavior.flows.

references.purpose: Trace endpoints resolve through canonical identity resolution.
Topic trace surfaces are projected deterministically with provenance.
Structural trace edges preserve their explicit dimension.
Only explicit flows supply execution causality in traces.

gaps.description: Legacy Topic field operation_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.
Legacy Topic field flow_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.

prose.summary: Defines forward and reverse canonical traceability so mechanisms can be followed from foundation to usage and from high-level Topic to runtime foundations without guessing.
notes: Unlocked until the assembled 1.4 tree provides complete forward and reverse trace closure.
Pass 8 formalized previously free Flow actor/data/target/condition/payload/result/error tokens as exact owner-scoped member identities while preserving every source literal.
